test_title: PYST 3: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: On 21 May 2025, the Director General of Health Services (DGHS) in Delhi was appointed to oversee the implementation of which two major healthcare initiatives?

options.text: PM-JAY and National Digital Health Mission
Fit India Movement and Swachh Bharat Abhiyan
Ayushman Bharat Health Infrastructure Mission and Ayushman Arogya Mandir

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ayushman Bharat Health Infrastructure Mission and Ayushman Arogya Mandir**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ayushman Bharat Health Infrastructure Mission (ABHIM):**

 
 
• Launched by the **Government of India** in **October 2021**, ABHIM focuses on strengthening public healthcare infrastructure across the country.
 
• The mission aims to build a robust system to respond to pandemics and health emergencies by developing critical care hospital blocks, diagnostic labs, and integrated public health labs. *This statement is correct.*
 
 
 
• **Ayushman Arogya Mandir:**
 
 
• The initiative is focused on promoting health and wellness through the establishment of wellness centers at a grassroots level. *This statement is correct.*
 
• These wellness centers are part of the vision to ensure preventive healthcare and awareness among citizens, thereby reducing the burden of diseases.
 
 
 
• The **Director General of Health Services (DGHS)** is the key administrative authority responsible for overseeing health-related programs and initiatives in India. Their role is crucial in implementing these missions effectively. *This statement is correct.*
 
• The appointment of DGHS on **21 May 2025** is pivotal for ensuring successful execution and monitoring of both initiatives across the country. *This statement is correct.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ayushman Bharat Health Infrastructure Mission (ABHIM):**

 
 
• **ABHIM** was introduced to strengthen **healthcare infrastructure** and enhance access to quality healthcare services across India, especially in rural and underserved areas.
 
• It emphasizes better preparedness for future pandemics by establishing **critical healthcare facilities**, including **integrated public health labs, critical care hospital blocks, and disease surveillance units**.
 
• The mission also includes training health personnel and establishing robust surveillance systems.
 
 
 
• **Ayushman Arogya Mandir:**
 
 
• Ayushman Arogya Mandirs aim to act as **wellness centers** to promote preventive healthcare and awareness among rural and urban populations.
 
• These centers focus on spreading awareness about **nutrition, cleanliness, and mental health** while providing basic diagnostic services.
 
 
 
• **Director General of Health Services (DGHS):**
 
 
• The **DGHS** operates under the **Ministry of Health and Family Welfare** and plays a significant role in managing and implementing healthcare policies and initiatives.
 
• The DGHS is responsible for coordinating efforts between central and state governments to ensure the success of healthcare missions.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Implementation of ABHIM:**

 
 
• The mission is designed to address gaps in health infrastructure and improve preparedness for health emergencies.
 
• It includes the establishment of **17,788 rural health and wellness centers** and **11,024 urban health and wellness centers**.
 
 
 
• **Role of Ayushman Arogya Mandir:**
 
 
• These centers aim to integrate traditional healthcare practices like **Ayurveda** and yoga with modern medical practices for holistic well-being.
 
• They are a step towards achieving universal healthcare and reducing the prevalence of lifestyle-related diseases.
 
 
 
• **DGHS Leadership:**
 
 
• The appointment of DGHS ensures proper monitoring and evaluation of these initiatives, ensuring they meet their goals effectively.
 
• The DGHS collaborates with other stakeholders to ensure the development and implementation of healthcare policies.
